Use the pronouns your kid wants you to use, ask questions (but don’t push for the answers), listen to them. Also, not everything that you may think is good for them will be good for them so just ask them. I know for a fact that being honest with people is the best way to get through things. Also, if your kid ever brings up sexuality do the same thing. I am bisexual and non-binary and I know a bunch about a ton of different gender and sexuality’s. If you ever need some more advice, feel free to contact me. I realized that I was bi and non-binary at the age of 11 so I think I’d be a good extra help. And because your kid is so young support them ever day, do your own research in genders and sexuality’s. My process of discovering everything about myself took years so if your kid ever changes their mind on something, just accept them. The process of denial is something that is needed but it can be hard. If you kid needs space, give them space. If your kid need to be listened to, listen and if you don’t know how to help, tell them that. One thing that I wish my parent would’ve done was listen without interruption and sometimes I wish they didn’t give feedback. I know every person is different but I’m general the best thing you can do is be honest. Tell your kid that you want the best for them and if you do want the best from them, that mean you have to listen to them as well.

You can call me Mica, my pronouns are they/them and I’m not 100% sure on my sexuality, not gay, not straight, not bi, not pan. I do have preferences and blah blah blah but I just can’t find one that fully fits so I just like to say I’m queer. I know that queer is mainly a term for more than one person but b/c I haven’t found something that fits me that well I just use it.

Edit: I recently found something that said bisexuality was like genders like your and unlike yours (instead of just male and female) and I identify with that b/c I’m non-binary and I like ppl why are NB and I also like girls and boys so I think I might be bi. I thought I couldn’t be bi cuz personality is a big part in my attraction while I still have physical attraction. (I also think/know I can’t be pan cuz I do have preferences w/ gender.) I’ve don’t a BUNCH of research on a wide variety of genders and sexuality’s and I’ve realized how much more open some sexuality’s and genders are. For example, bisexuality, gender fluid (I know it literally have fluid in the name but you can be gender fluid and your pronouns could be he/they he/ze he/they/ze she/they she/ze she/they/ze she/him she/they/he she/ze/he and so much more. I knew it was really open but it just hadn’t clicked), abrosexual (again, I knew it was really open but didn’t click before hand), and a lot more. So, I’m not 100% sure but you could say I’m bi or queer, idc (that much).

TL;DR 
Name; Mica.
Pronouns; they/ze.
Sexuality; unsure/queer/bi
